state_contract_cases.evidence: READY creates DRAW-0001 and atomically confirms ROUND-01-DRAW-0001 with EV-DRAW-REQUESTED then EV-ROUND-LOCKED.
Double activation produced exactly two total draw/lock pairs across initial and one new round; Round 01 advanced once to Round 02.
SAVE changed the button to SAVED while roundId, trackId and drawId remained unchanged.
EXCLUDE retained Playing and stored SYN-BB-007@R02 in pending exclusions with EV-EXCLUDE-DEFERRED.
Forced zero-candidate pool rendered CONTENT EMPTY with relax and undo recovery controls.
Failed new-round retained last-safe round/track; retry reused DRAW-0003 with a new attempt and then emitted EV-RECOVERED.
Fallback stayed hidden at failure 1/3 and 2/3, appeared at 3/3, reused DRAW-0002, and locked target Round 02 only after confirmed fallback Playing.
Reload without a scenario restored the same ROUND-01-DRAW-0001 and SYN-BB-007 in PAUSED.
Restart changed only attempt/restart fields, preserved draw/round/track, reset elapsed, and emitted no additional EV-ROUND-LOCKED.
Pause then resume retained roundId, trackId, drawId and progress position.
Save, pause/resume, restart and exclude all completed without creating a new drawId.
Pending SYN-BB-007 exclusion was respected by the next-round pool while the old round remained locked until success.
Restart failure exposed only RESTART SAME LOCKED TRACK; fallback was hidden and recovery preserved round/draw/track.
New-round empty/failure retained the confirmed last-safe round and did not advance roundNumber before success.
INFO-EVENT-LOG showed stable EV-* types, monotonically increasing EVENT-* sequence IDs and round/track/draw/attempt references.
Condition edit cancelled an in-flight new-round request; its later completion did not alter READY or create a lock event.
Successful Round 02 promoted one due pending exclusion to applied and cleared the pending set.
EMPTY energy relaxation reused DRAW-0002 and target Round 02, then emitted EV-RECOVERED after confirmed Playing.
